pages.lesson:
LESSON: ALCOHOL, DRUGS AND SUBSTANCE ABUSE

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Christian Living
Topic 5.4: Alcohol, Drugs and Substance Abuse

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Alcohol, Drugs and Substance Abuse
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why do young people abuse alcohol and drugs?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain Christian teachings on the dangers of alcohol, drugs and substance abuse

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: explain Christian teachings on the dangers of alcohol, drugs and substance abuse

Teach
• Today’s focus: explain Christian teachings on the dangers of alcohol, drugs and substance abuse.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “explain Christian teachings on the dangers of alcohol, drugs and substance abuse” using a school example.
• Model B for “explain Christian teachings on the dangers of alcohol, drugs and substance abuse” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "explain Christian teachings on the dangers of alcohol, drugs and substance abuse" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: explain Christian teachings on the dangers of alcohol, drugs and substance abuse

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: explain Christian teachings on the dangers of alcohol, drugs and substance abuse

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Alcohol, Drugs and Substance Abuse.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why do young people abuse alcohol and drugs?
2. How can you avoid alcohol, drugs and substance abuse?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• explain Christian teachings on the dangers of alcohol, drugs and substance abuse

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
